evidence: Coordinator and worker independently decoded the complete mapped function. At 463762 owner becomes -1; 4637A7..7B9 index row a4, column owner. The missing column physically reads PlayersData[a4].last_turn_new_base at +0x14 rather than diplo_treaties[0] at +0x18. Use the real member in this explicit sentinel case, not a huge unsigned index.

At 463927 owner again becomes -1, but 463931..3943 use row owner, column a4. This is a different original out-of-range access: address 0x96C9F8 - 0x20CC + 4*a4, or 0x96A92C + 4*a4. Vehs starts 0x952828 with stride 0x34; this lands inside its existing storage, at Vehs[1895]+0x18+4*a4. For valid active factions 1..7 the low-bit sources are waypoint_y[0], waypoint_y[2], morale, moves_expended, probe_action, next_veh_id_stack, and Vehs[1896].x. Preserve this apparently accidental renderer dependency explicitly through those typed fields; do not silently turn missing-owner into false or invent a dummy diplomacy row.

The worked-tile scan excludes a4<1 before these accesses; the supported game faction domain is 1..7. The source helper must document this domain and original-bug interpretation. This is not evidence that the original intended to read vehicle state. Require independent offset assertions and actual-source bit-toggle controls for every valid faction, plus an asymmetric ordinary treaty test to distinguish row/column reversal. No source-owned global is rehomed or redefined, no original-address pointer is introduced, and no game-acceptance claim follows.
